sentences.text: CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : M/s. Ranjan Kumar Ravidas, Advocate For the State : M/s. Lily Sahay, A.P.P.
-----
02/08.01.2025 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with S.T. Case No. 209/2024 arising out of Bharno P.S. Case No. 52/2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 303/2024, for the offences registered under Sections 376(2)
(n), 313 of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-Cum-Special Judge, Gumla.
3. The petitioner is alleged to have established physical relationship with the prosecutrix on the promise of marriage.
Later on, the petitioner refused to marry her.
It appears that the parties were in relationship for about two years.
4. In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-Cum-Special Judge, Gumla in connection with S.T. Case No. 209/2024 Md. Saif Alam @ Saif Alam vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
